plugin.name: Splinter Cell Fusion Fix
MAIN.ResX.description: Output width; 0 uses the desktop resolution. Restart required.
MAIN.ResY.description: Output height; 0 uses the desktop resolution. Restart required.
MAIN.ForceShadowBufferMode.description: Force the game's shadow-buffer rendering mode.
MAIN.ShadowBufferResolution.description: The game uses 2048. 0 keeps it, 1 uses the output width, other values set the size; larger sizes give sharper shadows. Limited to 4096. Restart required.
MAIN.RawInputMouse.description: Read mouse movement without the original dropped events. Restart required.
MAIN.RawInputMouseRawData.description: Use unaccelerated mouse movement. Restart required.
MAIN.HudAspectRatioConstraint.descriptio: Auto puts the HUD at the screen edges. A ratio such as 4:3, 16:9 or 21:9 keeps it in a centered area; 4:3 is the original layout. Applies immediately.
MAIN.GrainScale.description: Size of the night and thermal vision grain: 0 keeps the original size (finer at high resolutions), 1 matches 640x480. Applies immediately.
MAIN.SkipIntro.description: Skip startup logos and intro playback. Play Intro remains available from the main menu. In Enhanced, intro videos are controlled by its own setting instead.
MAIN.SkipPressStartToContinue.descriptio: Go past the startup button prompt automatically.
MAIN.CutsceneBorders.description: Framing of the cinematics, made for a 16:9 picture. Letterbox keeps the original bars on screens narrower than 16:9, Pillarbox puts bars at the sides of wider screens, Both does both. Off fills the screen. Applies immediately.
MISC.FPSLimit.description: Highest frame rate. 0 is unlimited, -1 follows the monitor's refresh rate; the original game stops at 200. 60 is recommended: higher rates can affect AI pathfinding and physics objects. Applies immediately.

menu.title: Advanced Options
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Language tag for Advanced Options and other plugins. auto follows the game language. Edit in the hub or CFG, then reopen Advanced Options.
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, a centered window, or borderless covering the monitor. Takes effect when the game starts. Alt+Enter switches fullscreen and the chosen window style.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the normal gameplay camera field of view. 1.0 keeps the intended framing; larger values widen the view. Scripted, aiming and gadget cameras keep their own framing.
MAIN.MouseSensitivity.description: Movement multiplier for raw mouse input. Applies immediately; preserves your choice when presets change.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Restore this plugin's settings. Press twice to confirm.
menu.presethelp: Choose a preset and press twice to apply it to this plugin.
MAIN.ConfineCursor.description: Keeps the mouse cursor inside the game window while the game is active, so it can't move to another monitor. Applies immediately.
MAIN.PauseOnFocusLoss.description: In windowed and borderless modes, pauses the game and its sound while another window is active, as the original does. Off keeps the game running in the background. Applies immediately.
MAIN.GamepadIcons.description: Button names in prompts while a pad is used. Auto uses Xbox names; keyboard and mouse input restores keyboard prompts.
MAIN.GamepadCameraSpeed.description: How fast the right stick turns the camera and aims. Applies immediately.
MAIN.InvertGamepadY.description: Pushing the right stick up looks down. The game's own Invert Mouse option turns the pad around too. Applies immediately.
MAIN.Vibration.description: Lets the pad rumble with shots, explosions and hits. Applies immediately.
MAIN.CheckForUpdates.description: Once per start, asks fusionfix.io whether a newer version of the fix is out and tells you in the game. Off makes no network request.
MAIN.SaveLocation.description: Where profiles and saves are kept. Game Folder is the game's own Save folder, Documents uses Documents\My Games\Splinter Cell. Saves are not moved: copy the contents of the Save folder over to keep playing them. Restart required.
update.availablehub: {name} {version} is available. FusionFixHub opens when you close the game.
startup.unsupported: This version of Splinter Cell isn't supported. The Fusion Fix needs version 1.3 (Steam, GOG, Ubisoft Connect, or a retail copy with the 1.3 patch). The game starts without the fix.
MAIN.FMVWidescreenMode.description: Original fits the whole video within a 4:3 area. Fill fits the whole video within the screen. Neither crops or stretches the picture.
